reserved_for_e2.rule: a forward window chosen by calendar, strictly after every period already spent or licensed; if the window does not exist yet, the campaign waits rather than substituting another period

hypothesis.statement: at a 30-minute horizon, requiring a positive direction-adjusted forward-drift estimate at the moment of entry raises the net expectancy of the registered families that already show positive gross edge at that horizon, by enough to clear the frozen round-trip cost plane
hypothesis.falsified_when: the screen reduces the trade count without raising net expectancy, or raises it by less than the plane, or the improvement does not hold in the validation partition — each of which is a published NOT_PROMOTE, not a failed run
hypothesis.why_one_candidate: the brief forbids creating a family to increase candidate count; E-2 is one screen over already-named families, and the pre-registration names them below

universe.why: the only 30m cells with a positive zero-cost gross edge in the rebuilt baseline; the list is taken from the phase-1 rebuild, not from a search
universe.runtime_contract: Strategy.evaluate(candles, indicators, config) -> Signal | None (src/trading_bot/strategies/protocols.py): the screen is an indicator computed from candles up to and including the decision bar plus a filter on the returned signal. No new runtime layer, no exchange access, no order path

windows.partition_rule: decision instants are split by calendar index — the first 60 % are development, the remainder validation — fixed now, before any observation exists, so no boundary can be moved after seeing a result

burned.note: W1-W7 carried the 24 registered cells and the 5m family diagnostics; RFC-049 spent its development and validation partitions on 2019-2023 and 2024-2026; its sealed OOS window opens at the timestamp above and has never been read. None of them may carry E-2's validation

windows.pit_rule: every input of a decision at instant T is available at or before T; the screen uses no candle whose close is after T, and the verification re-derives this with a point-in-time check rather than trusting the implementation

metrics: net expectancy bps per round trip, net of the frozen plane
lower 95 % confidence bound of that expectancy
sign of the net expectancy in the development partition and in the validation partition
trade count achieved against the pre-registered requirement
hit rate, payoff and exit mix, for the record
exposure and trades per day, compared with the 3-operations-per-day objective
cost under the 1.5x stress envelope, reported beside the headline

promote_requires: net expectancy positive in both development and validation
trade count >= required_trades(sd of the development partition, 23.3536 bps, 80 % power)
decision_rule.why_that_effect: an edge smaller than one round trip at the frozen plane cannot be net positive, so a sample that cannot resolve the plane cannot separate success from noise
kill_criteria: the screen cannot be expressed without reading an input from the future
the trade count after screening falls below the requirement within the reserved window, and the window may not be extended to reach it
the measured cost layer shows the plane is not the binding constraint, in which case the next experiment is the one E-1 names, not this one
any promotion would require changing a frozen threshold
